reason: A host-only DSH plugin for agent-driven browser automation using JavaScript in a locally connected Edge or Chrome runtime, with persistent task spaces, API help, and host diagnostics.

summaries.zh: 通过本机 Edge 或 Chrome 浏览器运行 JavaScript，帮助智能体完成网页导航、交互、数据提取和任务空间管理。
summaries.en: Runs JavaScript in a locally connected Edge or Chrome browser to help agents navigate webpages, interact with sites, extract data, and manage task spaces.

capabilities: Executes agent-supplied JavaScript in the local ego-browser Node.js runtime
Controls locally installed Edge or Chrome through CDP
Navigates webpages and performs browser interactions, searches, screenshots, form actions, and data extraction
Reuses persistent browser profiles, login sessions, and task spaces across calls
Spawns the ego-browser host process and can write browser state outside the session workspace
Provides API guidance and browser host diagnostics
